title: Use your Obsidian vault with AnchorCore
description: Keep your Obsidian vault. Point AnchorCore at the folder, sync, and ask: answers cite the exact note sections instead of dumping whole files into the AI.

title: Try the AnchorCore sample company
description: A ten-file fictional payments company to try every part of AnchorCore in a minute: download sample.zip, sync it, and ask cited questions.

title: Connect any JSON API to AnchorCore
description: Point AnchorCore at a JSON list API, map its fields once, preview five records, and sync. No per-integration code; items are cited as rest:<id>.

title: Try the AnchorCore AI startup sample
description: A second sample corpus: a fictional AI product company with model routing, evals and pricing decisions. Sync it and ask cited questions.
